people.name: Javan
people.line: Son of Japheth; ancestor of Greek people

translations.web: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.
translations.bsb: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, slave or free, and we were all given one Spirit to drink.
translations.kjv: For by one Spirit are ➔ we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been ➔ all made to drink into one Spirit.
translations.asv: For in one Spirit were we all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all made to drink of one Spirit.
